answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 23 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the ember solution is checked at the echo gate and logged, the karst audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch therefore pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. The deposit is 68 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
